name: projector
useCase: Select or identify a projector as a presentation display.
misuse: Do not use this hardware symbol for a camera or as confirmation that a presentation is visible.

16.reason: The lens sits on the canvas midline inside a taller housing, with at least 1px around it and a separate indicator; two short feet complete the projector silhouette.

24.reason: A larger lens and indicator sit on the canvas midline with at least 1.5px of space around them; the housing and feet use independent proportions.
